would-provide-true-live-soil-moisture-ch: Would provide true live soil moisture. Chash Orbit derives an estimate from POWER precipitation + a water-balance model instead, and labels it "derived" — never "live SMAP".
requires-earthdata-auth-via-nsidc-appeea: Requires Earthdata auth via NSIDC / AppEEARS. Demo uses POWER-derived substitute.
global-precipitation-measurement-integra: Global Precipitation Measurement (Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals) — high-resolution rainfall.
late-run-gpm-data-is-delivered-via-nasa-: Late-run GPM data is delivered via NASA GES DISC (Earthdata). POWER PRECTOTCORR already folds GPM in.
ndvi-vegetation-index-mod13-vnp13-produc: NDVI vegetation index (MOD13 / VNP13 products) — global vegetation health, every 16 days.
would-provide-true-live-ndvi-chash-orbit: Would provide true live NDVI. Chash Orbit derives a seasonal NDVI model from POWER precipitation + temperature climatology instead, and labels it "derived".
requires-earthdata-auth-via-appeears-lp-: Requires Earthdata auth via AppEEARS / LP DAAC. Demo uses POWER-derived substitute.
chash-orbit-turns-nasa-earth-observation: Chash Orbit turns NASA Earth-observation data into a transparent field-level recommendation. NASA POWER provides live temperature and rainfall data. Soil moisture, NDVI, and additional soil metrics are derived estimates — we never falsely label sample data as live NASA data.
temperature-rainfall-nasa-power-langley-: Temperature & rainfall: NASA POWER (Langley Research Center). Soil moisture, NDVI, and additional soil metrics are derived estimates (see attributions above).
chash-orbit-nasa-space-apps-challenge-ea: Chash Orbit · NASA Space Apps Challenge · Earth-to-farm decision system
soil-moisture-is-derived-from-nasa-power: Soil moisture is derived from NASA POWER precipitation + a water-balance model. Other soil metrics are derived from regional signals and farmer-reported texture. NASA does not directly measure every soil-health metric.
